comparison: unfixed conservative lower bound >= 1.5 * fixed upper bound over 3 paired rounds
scope: Normal app startup including automatic all-feed refresh. Identical ten RSS subscriptions, 100 articles per feed, 256-byte bodies, and 1.5-second external server response delay. Not a manual-refresh or CPU-reduction claim.
lower_bound: Last incomplete native database observation start minus launch-command return. Completion is also checked against the enabled normal refresh UI.
upper_bound: Start of normal launch command to completed native refresh plus normal UI checks.
native_profile: Same-run OS scheduling trace; evaluator markers stay outside app code and are removed from app-only agent export.
